product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic provides enterprises an integration and applied-AI platform that securely connects applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its Agentic Integration and Applied AI Platform as connecting enterprise applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.

pricing_page.notes: SnapLogic has a public pricing page describing its pricing model and Essential, Professional, and Enterprise One packages.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer page’s customer-logo wall includes Adobe and Sony. | named_customers.0: Adobe appears in SnapLogic’s customer logo wall. | named_customers.1: Sony appears in SnapLogic’s customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: SnapLogic’s LinkedIn company profile gives its company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company overview names San Mateo, California as SnapLogic’s headquarters. | hq_country: SnapLogic’s overview identifies its headquarters as San Mateo, California, which is in the United States.

founded_year.notes: SnapLogic’s company overview states that it was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: SnapLogic’s Technical Posts index describes technical insights into its architecture and platform, and lists multiple engineering-focused posts, including developer production clones and a data-engineering architecture article with named authors.

public_docs.notes: SnapLogic provides a public documentation site with multiple product sections, including AgentCreator and public API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: SnapLogic’s live Lever posting is titled Applied AI Architect and includes an application link, so an AI role is open.

model_provider.value: The company specifies Anthropic’s Claude Agent SDK for its enterprise agent product; its platform also documents integrations for Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, and Google Gemini.
model_provider.notes: A current SnapLogic Applied AI Architect posting says the enterprise agent product is being built on the Claude Agent SDK. Product documentation also lists integrations with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Amazon Bedrock foundation models, supporting the stated multi-provider coverage.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company security page explicitly lists SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA-HITECH, and GDPR compliance. ISO standards in the same passage are described as AWS capabilities, not SnapLogic certifications, so they are excluded. | compliance_certs.0: The security page names SOC 2 Type 2 as a SnapLogic certification. | compliance_certs.1: The security page says the SnapLogic platform is certified for HIPAA-HITECH. | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly states that the SnapLogic platform is compliant with GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile identifies Series H as the latest deal and dates it to December 2021. | funding_date: The latest-round entry on the funding profile dates the Series H to December 2021. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile, updated November 4, 2026, identifies the latest deal as a $165 million Series H round.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile updated November 4, 2026 lists the latest round as Series H in December 2021, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: SnapLogic’s current Sales Development Representative EMEA posting includes an Apply link, confirming an SDR opening.

launched_6mo.notes: SnapLogic announced new Agentic Integration Platform capabilities on October 20, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: SnapLogic announced on May 12, 2026 that Molly Matthews was appointed President, within the 12 months before the specified November 9, 2026 date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: SnapLogic’s SDR job posting tells employees to update prospect interactions in Salesforce and names ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, and LeadIQ among the sales tools used for the role. | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR posting states that prospect interactions are updated in Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The SDR posting names ZoomInfo among the role’s sales tools. | crm_stack_signal.2: The SDR posting names SalesLoft among the role’s sales tools. | crm_stack_signal.3: The SDR posting names LeadIQ among the role’s sales tools.
